families.label: Discovery/reference
families.outstanding: Search identifiers, screeners, directories and listing variants remain open beyond the first adapters.

families.label: Company intelligence
families.outstanding: Bounded historical capitalization and share-statistics queries have accepted Batch A live API evidence. Management, employee, compensation and broader company intelligence remain open; access is installation- and query-scoped.

families.label: Markets
families.outstanding: Batch A single-listing quote has scoped live API evidence. Batches, sessions, intraday and adjustment variants remain open; API acceptance does not establish quote widget behavior.

families.label: Financial analysis
families.outstanding: Batch A segment and statement-growth datasets have scoped live API comparisons. Browser acceptance, TTM and broader financial analysis remain open.

families.label: Reports/documents
families.outstanding: As-reported statements, annual-report JSON/XLSX and SEC filing discovery remain unimplemented.

families.label: Funds
families.outstanding: ETF information, holdings, exposures and fund disclosures remain unimplemented.

families.label: Expectations
families.outstanding: Batch A estimates, price-target events and consensus have scoped live API evidence. Broader broker/partner datasets and browser acceptance remain open.

families.label: News/events
families.outstanding: News, articles, releases, transcripts and corporate calendars remain unimplemented.

families.label: Ownership
families.outstanding: Institutional/13F, insider, beneficial and congressional ownership disclosures remain unimplemented.

families.label: Cross-market research
families.outstanding: Sector/industry performance, technical indicators and index constituents/history remain unimplemented.

families.label: Other assets
families.outstanding: FX, crypto, futures and commodities require explicit instrument/expiry/roll semantics and acceptance.

families.label: Macro/positioning
families.outstanding: Economic calendar, Treasury rates, risk premiums and COT report variants require separate acceptance.

families.label: Additional families
families.outstanding: ESG, fundraising, market hours and bulk delivery remain open; bulk is a transport choice.

families.label: Supplementary FRED
families.outstanding: Named FRED series are supplementary; installed schemas do not verify live account or widget behavior.

families.label: Supplementary Yahoo
